brief.text: Biotechnology and energy commitments top the individual table, led by Baker Bros. Advisors filing $35,023,032 in MDGL and $24,340,836 in KOD, alongside a $14,994,200 transaction in KMI by executive chairman Richard Kinder. In the cluster data, UPBD shows the broadest insider participation with seven distinct buyers totaling $1,390,755, while TTMI logged the largest cluster value at $3,616,552 across three insiders. Additionally, Saba Capital Management appears four separate times among notable individual purchases, filing entries across closed-end funds JOF, MXF, ECF, and GRX.
